answer: Each challenge commits to a task instance and a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse; the node must commit and reveal a valid response only after that pulse fixes an unpredictable salt. Assuming an honest beacon threshold, no participant can bias the value, so a sybil swarm cannot precompute solutions, farm offline, or select favorable identities. Labels such as vault, ember, and sonnet are useless without the authenticated future beacon, binding effort to real-time participation.
